title: Swamp Terror
summary: A druid's charmed alligator reveals the Swamp Terror.
overview: A druid's charmed alligator reveals the Swamp Terror.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Bring the required charmed alligator to the quest trigger with the group prepared.
The dialogue sequence ends with the Swamp Terror appearing nearby.
Have a tank ready to engage as soon as the creature emerges.
